p:cNvPr.descr: To the right there is a key showing the colors and molar extinction coefficient (MEC) associated with each nucleotide. It is in a box with text reading, "Molar extinction coefficient at 260 nm, epsilon 260 (M1 to the -1 cm to the -1)." Below are the nucleotides. AMP is shown by a blue line with MEC 15,400; GMP is shown by a green line with MEC 11,700; UMP is shown by an orange line with MEC 9,900; dTMP is shown by a purple line with MEC 9,200; CMP is shown by a red line with MEC 7,500. To the left, outside the box, is the graph. The vertical axis is labeled "molar extinction coefficent, epsilon" with range 2000 to 14000 and interval 2000. Horizontal axis is labeled "wavelength (nm) with range 230 to 280 and interval 10. The MEC for each nucleotide was provided above. All colors are present on the graph. AMP reaches the highest peak at 260 nm, while the lowest is CMP at approximately 275 nm.
